title: Back to the gate
goals: Reach the spot before the gate.
starting_code:
# This program gets there, but it bumps into the gate. Make it better!
wizard.move_left(4)
wizard.move_up(6)
hints: Watch what happens when you run the program to see where the wizard bumps.
One of the moves goes too far.
Change the argument of the `move_up` method so your wizard stops before the gate.
intro: I wrote a program to walk back to the gate, but it could be better. It gets there, but your wizard bumps into the shut gate!
outro: Much better! Now we stop exactly where we need to, without bumping into anything.
learned: Now you know that a program that works can still be made better, here by giving each move the argument it needs.
